transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

The 'dE' code on LG appliances typically indicates a Door Error or that the door is locked for safety reasons (often because it's still hot from drying). Please leave the machine switched ON and wait 5–10 minutes to see if the lock releases naturally. If that doesn't work, switch it OFF at the wall socket, wait another 5 minutes, and try opening the handle again. Did the door open after waiting?
its not locked, the door wont even let it start. it just clicks then dE. does it matter that its got a king size duvet in?

Yes, a king-size duvet is very likely the cause. They soak up water and clump to one side, making the drum unbalanced so the machine refuses to start or spin. Please pause the cycle (if it allows), open the door, manually spread the duvet out evenly around the drum, close it firmly until you hear a click, and try starting again. If that doesn't work, the 'DE' code and clicking sound suggest the door interlock might be faulty or not registering correctly. Try unplugging the machine for 5 minutes to reset the electronics, then plug it back in and try again with the duvet spread out.
ok tried closing it properly, it shuts but kinda springs back a bit. unplugged it for a bit too and its still dE with the duvet in. the duvet is bulging against the glass tho

The fact that the door 'springs back' when you close it suggests the mechanical catch or handle isn't engaging fully. The heavy duvet is likely pushing against the glass and preventing the latch from hooking in properly. Before we look at parts, please try this: open the door, remove the duvet to clear the pressure, then close the empty door firmly until it clicks. If it stays shut, run a quick 'Spin' programme with no load. If the machine starts and spins normally when empty but fails again with the duvet inside, the issue is simply an unbalanced load or the catch struggling under that weight. If it still shows DE even when empty, we will need your model number to identify if the door interlock itself needs replacing.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
took the duvet out n tried towels instead and it starts fine. model is FWV796WTSE btw

That's excellent news. It suggests the issue was simply the heavy duvet clumping against the glass and preventing the door catch from engaging properly. To avoid this happening again with large items like duvets or pillows, try to spread them out evenly around the drum before starting, or add a couple of smaller towels to help balance the load. If you need any further advice on washing large bedding items in future, just let me know.
